cards.example_en: The fourteenth of March is my cousin's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 三月十四日是我表弟的生日。

cards.example_en: Only the fifteenth runner was still smiling at the finish.
cards.example_zh: 只有第十五名跑到终点时还在笑。

cards.example_en: Her name is sixteenth on the class register.
cards.example_zh: 她的名字在班级名册上排第十六。

cards.example_en: We get off at the seventeenth stop on this bus route.
cards.example_zh: 我们在这条公交线路的第十七站下车。

cards.example_en: Her birthday is on the eighteenth of June.
cards.example_zh: 她的生日是六月十八日。

cards.example_en: The nineteenth question was the hardest on the paper.
cards.example_zh: 第十九题是试卷上最难的。

cards.example_en: She finished twentieth in the race.
cards.example_zh: 她在比赛中名列第二十。

cards.example_en: Today is the thirtieth of April, the day before Labour Day.
cards.example_zh: 今天是四月三十日，劳动节的前一天。

cards.example_en: This is the school's fortieth sports day.
cards.example_zh: 这是学校的第四十届运动会。

cards.example_en: Grandma celebrated her fiftieth birthday with the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶和全家一起过了五十岁生日。

cards.example_en: The sixtieth pupil in the queue finally got a ticket.
cards.example_zh: 队列里第六十个学生终于买到了票。

cards.example_en: They planted the seventieth tree behind the library.
cards.example_zh: 他们在图书馆后面种下了第七十棵树。

cards.example_en: Mr Lin retired on his eightieth birthday.
cards.example_zh: 林老师在八十岁生日那天退休了。

cards.example_en: She scored on the ninetieth minute and saved the match.
cards.example_zh: 她在第九十分钟进球，挽救了比赛。

cards.example_en: This is the hundredth word I have learned this month.
cards.example_zh: 这是我这个月学的第一百个单词。

cards.example_en: She hopes to travel across Africa one day.
cards.example_zh: 她希望有一天能穿越非洲旅行。

cards.example_en: An African joined our basketball team last September.
cards.example_zh: 去年九月，一位非洲人加入了我们的篮球队。

cards.example_en: My cousin studies history in America this year.
cards.example_zh: 我表哥今年在美国学习历史。

cards.example_en: Our host family cooked an American breakfast with pancakes.
cards.example_zh: 寄宿家庭给我们做了有煎饼的美式早餐。

cards.example_en: Few people live in Antarctica because it is extremely cold.
cards.example_zh: 因为极度寒冷，几乎没有人住在南极洲。

cards.example_en: Many of my relatives live in different parts of Asia.
cards.example_zh: 我的不少亲戚住在亚洲不同的地方。

cards.example_en: We ordered Asian noodles at the small restaurant downtown.
cards.example_zh: 我们在市中心的小餐馆点了亚洲面条。

cards.example_en: My pen friend in Australia sent a photo of kangaroos.
cards.example_zh: 我在澳大利亚的笔友寄来了一张袋鼠照片。

cards.example_en: My Australian pen friend sent photos of a beach near Sydney.
cards.example_zh: 我的澳大利亚笔友寄来了悉尼附近海滩的照片。

cards.example_en: They spent the summer holiday in Britain.
cards.example_zh: 他们的暑假是在英国度过的。

cards.example_en: British coins look different from the ones in my pocket.
cards.example_zh: 英国硬币和我口袋里的那些看起来不一样。

cards.example_en: My aunt sends postcards from Canada every winter.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑每年冬天都从加拿大寄来明信片。

cards.example_en: My Canadian uncle coaches ice hockey at a local rink.
cards.example_zh: 我的加拿大叔叔在当地溜冰场教冰球。

cards.example_en: They travelled to England last summer.
cards.example_zh: 他们去年夏天去了英格兰。

cards.example_en: My uncle took the train across Europe and posted a card from each city.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔坐火车穿越欧洲，每到一座城市就寄一张明信片。

cards.example_en: European cities appear often in our geography worksheets this term.
cards.example_zh: 欧洲城市经常出现在我们这学期的地理练习里。

cards.example_en: They spent a week in France.
cards.example_zh: 他们在法国待了一周。

cards.example_en: We bought French bread and cheese for the class picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我们为班级野餐买了法式面包和奶酪。

cards.example_en: My aunt teaches violin at a college in Germany.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑在德国一所学院教小提琴。

cards.example_en: Our German exchange student shared homemade cake at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们的德国交换生午饭时分享了自制蛋糕。

cards.example_en: They spent the holiday in India.
cards.example_zh: 他们在印度度假。

cards.example_en: We tried Indian food at a restaurant near the school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校附近的餐馆吃了印度菜。

cards.example_en: We ate lemon ice cream on a warm evening in Italy.
cards.example_zh: 我们在意大利一个暖和的晚上吃了柠檬冰淇淋。

cards.example_en: Dad cooked Italian pasta for Sunday dinner.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸星期天的晚饭做了意大利面。

cards.example_en: Cherry trees were in bloom when we landed in Japan.
cards.example_zh: 我们降落在日本时，樱花正在开放。

cards.example_en: We learned a Japanese song for the school concert.
cards.example_zh: 我们为学校音乐会学了一首日本歌。

cards.example_en: We changed trains in London on our way to the coast.
cards.example_zh: 去海边的路上，我们在伦敦换了火车。

cards.example_en: Her pen pal lives in New York and writes every month.
cards.example_zh: 她的笔友住在纽约，每个月都写信。

cards.example_en: New Zealand is famous for sheep and green hills.
cards.example_zh: 新西兰以绵羊和青山闻名。

cards.example_en: The New Zealander in our class taught us a Maori greeting.
cards.example_zh: 我们班的新西兰同学教了我们一句毛利问候语。

cards.example_en: Paris is the city she wants to see after the exams.
cards.example_zh: 巴黎是她考完试想去的城市。

cards.example_en: The story is set in Russia.
cards.example_zh: 故事发生在俄罗斯。

cards.example_en: We watched a Russian cartoon with Chinese subtitles.
cards.example_zh: 我们看了一部带中文字幕的俄罗斯动画片。

cards.example_en: We changed planes in Singapore on the way to Australia.
cards.example_zh: 我们去澳大利亚途中在新加坡转机。

cards.example_en: Our Singaporean neighbour brought mooncakes at Mid-Autumn.
cards.example_zh: 中秋时我们的新加坡邻居带来了月饼。
